title: Triage names the phase a run stopped in
description: The docket entry for a stopped run should say which phase it stopped in, so the development manager reads the stoppage without opening the run.
design: Read the phase off the run record at the time the docket entry is made.
acceptance_criteria: Every docket entry for a stopped run names the phase; a run with no phase recorded says so.
notes:
Goal served: the harness's surfaces read clearly.

Blocked: run run-5035c832 stopped on it; the reviewer asked for repair and the repair budget is spent.

run.failure: the reviewer asked for repair 3 times and the repair budget is spent: the change reads a style it does not set
run.reason: review: the reviewer asked for repair 3 times and the repair budget is spent: the change reads a style it does not set
